command:
set -eu
source_dir="$HOME/managed-allocation-metrics-source-paired-0c502c4800ab41dbe72be6c669c8e64f6888bb19"
target_dir="$HOME/managed-allocation-metrics-target-paired-0c502c4800ab41dbe72be6c669c8e64f6888bb19"
records="$HOME/managed-allocation-metrics-light-paired-0c502c4800ab41dbe72be6c669c8e64f6888bb19"
test ! -e "$source_dir"
test ! -e "$target_dir"
test ! -e "$records"
mkdir "$source_dir" "$target_dir" "$records"
python3 - "$source_dir" "$records" <<'PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); records=Path(sys.argv[2])
files=[{"name":"paired.py","sha256":"1e139e610572f834398baae4138f1a1154ccaa64b9994fab410702010a22a173","base64":""},{"name":"test_paired.py","sha256":"b75e8f60c6f732f2adb06f870642f009f7d4e6fa32a9505204f29caab6ba0162","base64":""}]
for item in files:
    data=base64.b64decode(item['base64'],validate=True)
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=item['sha256']: raise SystemExit('source digest mismatch')
    with (root/item['name']).open('xb') as f: f.write(data)
(records/'source.json').write_text(json.dumps({'revision':'0c502c4800ab41dbe72be6c669c8e64f6888bb19','files':[{k:v for k,v in item.items() if k!='base64'} for item in files]},indent=2)+'\n')
exe=Path(sys.executable).resolve()
with exe.open('rb') as f: digest=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
(records/'python.json').write_text(json.dumps({'version':sys.version,'executable':str(exe),'sha256':digest},indent=2)+'\n')
PY
cd "$source_dir"
printf '%s\n' 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 SHARDS_METRICS_LIGHT_TMP=<new private target> python3 -m unittest -v test_paired; pure/synthetic only, no paired.main or subprocess/VM/profile run' > "$records/unit.command"
set +e
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 SHARDS_METRICS_LIGHT_TMP="$target_dir" python3 -m unittest -v test_paired > "$records/unit.log" 2>&1
result=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$result" > "$records/unit.exit"
python3 - "$records" <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);rows=[]
for p in sorted(root.iterdir()):
    if p.is_file(): rows.append({'path':p.name,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(root/'MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print((root/'unit.log').read_text())
PY
exit "$result"
